```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

## Film Budgets and Revenue

Do films with larger budgets generate higher box-office revenues? @fig-budget-revenue shows the relationship between production budgets and worldwide revenues.

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Production Budget VS Worldwide Box-Office Revenue"
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()
```
